def iso(o):
    if isinstance(o,(datetime.datetime,datetime.date)): return o.isoformat()
    if isinstance(o,dict): return {k:iso(v) for k,v in o.items()}
    if isinstance(o,list): return [iso(v) for v in o]
    return o
async def iam(op,params):
    return await call_boto3(service_name="iam",operation_name=op,region_name="us-east-1",params=params)
A="229251310592"
CI="munaxa-shared-ci-nonprod-session"; DEP="munaxa-shared-deployer-nonprod-session"
files={}
r=await iam("ListRoles",{"PathPrefix":"/munaxa-shared/bootstrap/"})
files["roles.json"]=[{"RoleName":x["RoleName"]} for x in r["Roles"]]
for n in (CI,DEP):
    files[f"role-{n}.json"]=iso((await iam("GetRole",{"RoleName":n}))["Role"])
    files[f"inline-names-{n}.json"]=(await iam("ListRolePolicies",{"RoleName":n}))["PolicyNames"]
    files[f"attached-{n}.json"]=(await iam("ListAttachedRolePolicies",{"RoleName":n}))["AttachedPolicies"]
files[f"inline-{CI}-assume-own-session-deployer-only.json"]=(await iam("GetRolePolicy",{"RoleName":CI,"PolicyName":"assume-own-session-deployer-only"}))["PolicyDocument"]
files[f"inline-{DEP}-session-deployer.json"]=(await iam("GetRolePolicy",{"RoleName":DEP,"PolicyName":"session-deployer"}))["PolicyDocument"]
for i,arn in enumerate([f"arn:aws:iam::{A}:policy/munaxa-shared/bootstrap/munaxa-shared-deployer-nonprod-session-read",f"arn:aws:iam::{A}:policy/munaxa-shared/bootstrap/munaxa-shared-deployer-read"]):
    v=(await iam("GetPolicy",{"PolicyArn":arn}))["Policy"]["DefaultVersionId"]
    files[f"policy-{i}.json"]=(await iam("GetPolicyVersion",{"PolicyArn":arn,"VersionId":v}))["PolicyVersion"]["Document"]
files["state-key.json"]=(await call_boto3(service_name="kms",operation_name="DescribeKey",region_name="eu-central-1",params={"KeyId":"alias/munaxa-shared-tfstate"}))["KeyMetadata"]["Arn"]
ec2=lambda op,p: call_boto3(service_name="ec2",operation_name=op,region_name="eu-central-1",params=p)
v=(await ec2("DescribeVpcs",{"Filters":[{"Name":"tag:Name","Values":["munaxa-nonprod"]}]}))["Vpcs"]
files["vpcs.json"]=iso(v)
vid=v[0]["VpcId"]
f=[{"Name":"vpc-id","Values":[vid]}]
files["subnets.json"]=iso((await ec2("DescribeSubnets",{"Filters":f}))["Subnets"])
files["route-tables.json"]=iso((await ec2("DescribeRouteTables",{"Filters":f}))["RouteTables"])
files["endpoints.json"]=iso((await ec2("DescribeVpcEndpoints",{"Filters":f}))["VpcEndpoints"])
files["sgs.json"]=iso((await ec2("DescribeSecurityGroups",{"Filters":f}))["SecurityGroups"])
files["igws.json"]=iso((await ec2("DescribeInternetGateways",{"Filters":[{"Name":"tag:Name","Values":["munaxa-nonprod-igw"]}]}))["InternetGateways"])
result={"fetched_at":datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z","files":files}
result
